purpose_cn: 恢复完整六域，以更大的均衡训练/观测集复核共享桥域相位失同步，并把离散有效年龄提升为可交叉拟合的共享时钟代价。
pre_effect_revision: After protocol freeze but before any six-domain model effect was read, the statistics runner was completed with the already frozen adjudication gates and M16 reporting; no formula, threshold, sample, checkpoint, or training setting changed.
why_six_domains_cn: 原始数据和早期训练制度一直包含 RainDS-syn。2026-08-24 五域版本是一次人为冻结的权威子协议，并非 RainDS-syn 数据缺失或科学无效。本协议作为新的六域总体从头重训，禁止把旧五域 checkpoint 与新增域直接拼接。

data.selection: sha256(protocol_id|domain|stem|role); heldout first, trainA disjoint; prior five-domain phase identities excluded from heldout where applicable

training.exposure_alignment: Single e1 and AIO e1 each expose the focal domain about 120 times
training.optimizer_clock_alignment: Single e6 and AIO e1 each contain 720 optimizer steps
arms: six task-specific Single models, checkpoints e1..e6
one six-domain AIO model, checkpoint e1

measurement.off_trajectory_control: min KDD versus max(proposal floor, Single age-span), retained as a boundary rather than a required positive result

primary_statistic.name_cn: 交叉拟合共享时钟遗憾
primary_statistic.crossfit_definition: select common clock c and domain clocks e_d on fold A, evaluate D^-1 sum_d [K_B,d,t(c)-K_B,d,t(e_d)] on fold B; swap folds and average
primary_statistic.folding: within each domain, deterministic SHA-256 balanced 40/40 split
primary_statistic.inference: 5000 independent within-domain train-fold and evaluation-fold bootstrap resamples; refit clocks on every draw
support_gate: cross-fitted regret > 0 at all three bridge times
one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0 at at least two of three bridge times
positive bootstrap fraction >= 0.95 at at least two of three bridge times
at least three distinct full-sample domain phases at at least two of three bridge times

secondary_statistics.phase_distribution: nonparametric bootstrap distribution of argmin age for each domain and bridge time
secondary_statistics.phase_wasserstein_energy: D^-1 sum_d W2^2(Pi_d,t, WassersteinBarycenter_d Pi_d,t), computed by one-dimensional quantile averaging
secondary_statistics.phase_reliability_ratio: between-domain phase variance / (between-domain phase variance + mean within-domain bootstrap phase variance)
secondary_statistics.domain_time_phase_shear: mean over adjacent bridge-time intervals of across-domain variance in bootstrap-mean phase increments

adjudication.rain_ds_boundary: RainDS-syn exhausts the 200-image local source at 120 trainA + 80 heldoutA; no external confirmation remains

headfigure_plan: A: six task-specific clocks versus one shared AIO clock
B: six reciprocal-KDD age profiles at the representative bridge time
C: six-domain by bridge-time effective phase field with bootstrap certainty
D: cross-fitted shared-clock regret and bootstrap intervals
F: tangential phase-regret versus off-trajectory residual boundary
forbidden_post_effect_changes: change AIO e1 or Single e1..e6
change bridge times or M to strengthen the figure
call image bootstrap a training-seed replication
claim quality harm or method effectiveness
